title: Chapter 109: Second Special Visitor
html:
The first three Nightmare Missions resembled a game’s introductory quests. They carried real danger, but also taught new players how the system worked.

Only after completing the first three Nightmare Missions does someone become a real player.Bloodstained paper in hand, Chen Ge struggled to calm himself. Every mission so far had threatened his life, yet those had been the beginner stages. How dangerous would the later ones become?

He stored the note and accepted what lay ahead. His two Trial Missions had been the hardest so far, yet the greatest danger at Ping An Apartments came from living people. Mu Yang High School was unnerving, but its lingering spirits meant no harm. By the black phone’s standards, neither mission had been exceptionally dangerous.

Looks like from three-star scenarios onwards, the situation will be different. I’ll probably encounter malicious specters then.In any case, Chen Ge could only power forward. This paper had probably been left behind by his parents, so no matter what, he had to pay the location a visit.

He took out the black phone. Seeing the girl’s face had completed the Nightmare Mission.

“Specters’ Favored, congratulations on completing the Nightmare Mission. Reward obtained: Elementary Skill—Dollmaker’s Talent.

“Using a real person as your model, carve, cut, join, and polish every bone. Paint the skin, stitch the wounds, and complete it with a flawless face. Offer it to a homeless spirit, and you will have created your first living doll.

“This was your third Nightmare Mission. As a completion reward, you may randomly draw a scenario’s Trial Mission. Would you like to draw now?

“Warning: Having completed your third Nightmare Mission, all future Daily Nightmare Missions will be randomized. Treat every opportunity with care!”

As when he received Mortician’s Makeup, unfamiliar memories and techniques entered his mind. Otherwise, nothing visibly changed.

Dolls and mannequins are essential to any Haunted House. This skill will be invaluable—and Mu Yang High School happens to contain twenty-four spirits who need bodies. I can use them to test it.Whether the spirits wanted to inhabit his creations did not enter his calculations. Once the dolls are finished and the spirits are inside them, Mu Yang High School’s Hidden Mission should be complete.

Night of the Living Dead did not contain enough mannequins, and the Haunted House lacked the equipment to produce them in bulk.

Tomorrow morning, I should go around to look for a workshop that can help me produce mannequins. Hopefully, the price won’t be too exorbitant.Chen Ge continued to look through the black phone. He was hesitating over whether he should draw the Trial Mission or not. In the end, he did not think that he was ready to take on a three-star Trial Mission.

With that settled, Chen Ge stopped his phone’s recording and clipped the section in which the slippers entered by themselves and stopped beside the bed.

“Whenever I fall asleep, the slippers walk to my bed.” With that hastily chosen title, he uploaded the eleven-second clip. Despite its brevity, it worked far better than the bathtub video. Within minutes, it had more than a hundred views and fifty shares, and his long-quiet comment section came alive.

“Small and weak! Your video is similar to your… Wait, can someone tell me why the slippers can move on their own?”

“Have you photoshopped yourself out of the video?”

“Am I mistaken? Or is there someone hiding under the bed?”

“I see it, too! But there appears to be two of them! F*ck, what in heaven’s name is this?!”

Every new video brought more followers. After reading comments for another two minutes, Chen Ge logged out and returned to bed. The next morning, he swept away the rice and cleaned the Haunted House before the park opened.

The lack of employees is a problem. If only the Pen Spirit could help me sell tickets…

He began planning. Minghun could accommodate only three visitors at a time, but Murder by Midnight and Mu Yang High School were different. Larger groups made Murder by Midnight more exciting, and Mu Yang High School was spacious enough for eight. With careful pacing, he could still terrify every one of them.

After completing Mu Yang High School’s Hidden Mission, I should have Xu Wan manage the Murder by Midnight scenario, and I’ll enter the Mu Yang High School scenario. That way, two scenarios can operate at the same time.

With the plan settled, Chen Ge searched for mannequin workshops in western Jiujiang. One stood near New Century Park and had once counted the park as its main customer. As the park declined, the workshop had followed; its owner now appeared ready to sell.

The park opened promptly at 9:00 a.m. Overall attendance continued to decline, but the Haunted House’s line grew. Not long ago, Chen Ge had stood outside with flyers, watching visitors pass him by. Even the carousel had drawn a longer queue. Now the situation was reversed.

“Please stay in line. Each scenario costs twenty RMB. If you want to try another afterward, return to the back of the queue.”

Xu Wan went inside to prepare while Chen Ge remained outside to sell tickets and maintain order. In the middle of a sale, the black phone vibrated.

The day has just started, and there’s already a message?Chen Ge stood where he was and pulled out the phone.

“The Midnight Ticket Counter’s effect has been triggered. A special visitor has appeared! Seize this opportunity. Your choices will determine the outcome!”

Again?Startled, Chen Ge scanned the line. Which one is the special visitor?

His eyes widened when he reached the end of the queue. The man there recognized him and waved.

“Doctor Gao?”

Chen Ge sent two visitors into the Minghun scenario before he walked over to Doctor Gao and studied the man closely. “Why are you here?”

“To find you, of course.” Dressed in a suit, Doctor Gao looked nothing like a typical park visitor. “I knew you were no longer a student, but I didn’t expect you to own a Haunted House.”

“It’s a family business.” Chen Ge pocketed his black phone and said, “Then, how can I help you?”

“I’ve encountered an unusual patient. His condition resembles the boy you told me about, so I wanted to ask you a few questions.”
